description_en: Queries the custom rules of frequency control (HTTP flood mitigation) for website services
description_zh: 查询网站业务频率控制防护（CC防护）的自定义规则
name: DescribeWebCCRules

parameters.help_en: The ID of the resource group to which the Anti-DDoS Pro or Anti-DDoS Premium instance belongs in Resource Management. This parameter is empty by default, which indicates that the instance belongs to the default resource group
parameters.help_zh: DDoS高防实例在资源管理产品中所属的资源组ID。默认为空，即属于默认资源组
parameters.name: resource_group_id

parameters.help_en:
The domain name of the website service.
The domain name must have a website service forwarding rule configured. You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/91724.html to query all domain names
parameters.help_zh:
网站业务的域名。
域名必须已配置网站业务转发规则。您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/91724.html查询所有域名
parameters.name: domain

parameters.help_en: The page number of the page to return in a paging query. For example, to query the first page, set this parameter to 1
parameters.help_zh: 分页查询请求时返回的页码。例如，查询第一页的返回结果，则填写1
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en: The number of records displayed on each page
parameters.name: page_size

TotalCount.description_en: The total number of frequency control (HTTP flood mitigation) custom rules
TotalCount.description_zh: 频率控制（CC防护）自定义规则的总数

WebCCRules.description_en: The frequency control (HTTP flood mitigation) custom rules
WebCCRules.description_zh: 频率控制（CC防护）自定义规则

Act.description_en:
The blocking type. Valid values:
close: blocks the request.
captcha: implements CAPTCHA verification
Act.description_zh:
阻断类型。取值：
close：封禁
captcha：人机识别

Count.description_en: The number of visits from a single IP address. Valid values: 2 to 2000
Count.description_zh: 单一IP访问次数。取值范围：2~2000

Interval.description_en: The detection interval. Valid values: 5 to 10800. Unit: seconds
Interval.description_zh: 检测间隔。取值范围：5~10800，单位：秒

Mode.description_en:
The matching mode. Valid values:
prefix: prefix match.
match: exact match
Mode.description_zh:
匹配模式。取值：
prefix：前缀匹配
match：完全匹配

Ttl.description_en: The blocking duration. Valid values: 1 to 1440. Unit: minutes
Ttl.description_zh: 封禁时长。取值范围：1~1440，单位：分钟
